chunks: About the one who is fast and the one who is slow in tawaf, he said: "Both are permissible so long as no one is harmed."

key_terms.الطَّوَافِ: tawaf, the ritual circumambulation around the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْأَعْرَجُ: al-A'raj, the epithet of the narrator Sa'id
key_terms.سَعِيدٌ: Sa'id, the named questioner in the report

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to walk fast or slow during tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about variation in pace during tawaf. Moving quickly or slowly is allowed, provided that a person does not cause harm or disturbance to others performing the rite.
